main_text.p: exauctoratus, per multos annos veluti invasor, muneribus Sacerdotalibus, & Pontificalibus spoliatus, priuatam vitam agens, postmodum per vim ab Imperatoribus sedi redditus, absque praevio examine, nulla causae disquisitione a summo Pontifice statim approbabitur? Credant Photiani; Pontificum Romanorum illius temporis alii mores, aliae constitutiones Ecclesiae, alia Canonum observatio. Et eos non ita facile mutare sua scribit Iosephus Methonensis, Responsione in Libellum Marci Ephesii contra Synodum Florentinam. Δόγμα δὲ ἡ ἴδιος τὶ τῆς οἰκείων ᾧ ἀ[?] πρὸς σε, ἡ τῆς μὴ σε ἡ χρεία λῷ. Ἔνθα γὰρ ἡ ἀκραντήλυτος σοφία διδάσκει, καὶ τελείως ἐργάζεται ἐωυτοῦ ἐχιστὲ[?], ἐ Δημιτον ἀ[?] δόγμα πιστόν. Sed neque opus erat, ipsos a te vel a tuis edoctos dogma mutare vel institutū[?]; ubi enim germana docetur sapientia, & perfectos illa efficit sui studiosos, non est fas, instituti aut dogma Fidei commntari. Quod experientia edoctus ipse Ephesius confirmat ibidem; Ἐυ δὲ ἡμῖν ἀποχωρᾶν τὸ πέλας σωθῆναι, καὶ τις ἡμῖν ἀπέκτεινεν ἰδῶν εἰς πλησίον ἄλλων. χρὴ γὰρ αὖ αἱ ἀνδρες ἔξω τ' οἰκείων ἐσθ' ν' [illegible, ~12 letters] Confestim quidem nobis desperatio finis obuenit, & prope quis stantem sic est affarier orsus: haud fa-

page.notes: The Greek lines are faint and partly blurred; the readings marked [?] are doubtful, and the final Greek stretch is illegible. "commntari" appears to be a printing error for "commentari", left as printed. "instituti" may carry a macron (institutū). The catchword "ne" is at the bottom right and is not repeated in the text.
